ai.howItWorksTitle: From your question to an evidence-backed answer
ai.howItWorksSubtitle: How Pragma processes every clinical query.

steps.title: Ask
steps.text: Type your query in natural language, like talking to a colleague.

steps.title: Find evidence
steps.text: The system searches thousands of papers and clinical guides instantly.

steps.title: Analyze and respond
steps.text: The AI generates a response based exclusively on the sources found.

steps.title: Verify and cite
steps.text: Assigns a confidence level and adds corresponding citations.

steps.title: Get the result
steps.text: Clinical answer with sources, confidence level, and disclaimer.

layers.name: User Interface
layers.desc: What you see: chat screen, buttons, dashboard

layers.name: Orchestration (MCP)
layers.desc: Coordinates everything: routes queries, searches relevant information

layers.name: Artificial Intelligence
layers.desc: The AI model that thinks, reasons, and generates clinical responses (vLLM + RAG)

layers.name: Knowledge Base
layers.desc: Papers, clinical guides, and books stored in Qdrant + PostgreSQL

layers.name: Infrastructure
layers.desc: Servers, GPUs, and Docker containers on OpenBSD

layers.name: Security
layers.desc: Firewall, encryption, network segmentation, and access controls

security.title: Designed for Compliance. Built to Protect.
items: Full encryption at rest (LUKS2) and in transit (TLS 1.3)
Network segmented into 6 zones: DMZ, Admin, App, Data, GPU, Backup
OpenBSD firewall — the world's most secure operating system
Continuous monitoring with Prometheus, Grafana, and Wazuh SIEM
